title: crypto2dev CI: FIPS mode validation (Rocky 9 + Ubuntu Pro)
description: Validate the FIPS mode path for the crypto2dev shim. Rocky 9: DISTRO=rocky FIPS_MODE=1 TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1. Ubuntu Pro: FIPS_MODE=1 UA_TOKEN=$UA_TOKEN TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1. With FIPS mode active, crypto2dev_wolfssl.ko should load a FIPS-validated wolfcrypt.ko and all REQUIRE_FIPS checks should succeed. Verify: (1) FIPS state in /sys/class/misc/crypto2dev/fips_state shows OPERATIONAL, (2) all shim tests pass, (3) shim test suite does not trigger any fallback to software (all operations served by FIPS-validated hardware).
notes: For Ubuntu FIPS, the 5.15-fips kernel is used. For Rocky, fips=1 is a boot parameter. The wolfcrypt.ko built in CI is not a FIPS-validated binary (requires commercial CMVP artifact) — but the FIPS path in crypto2dev can still be tested with a non-FIPS wolfcrypt.ko by verifying the REQUIRE_FIPS ioctl behavior (returns ENOENT when no FIPS provider loaded).
